name: Foundation Orbits
description: Shared SDS OMM/OPM/OEM/OCM/CDM/GRV/CRD orbit conversion module for Orekit-compatible elliptical and hyperbolic Keplerian mean elements, Cartesian state vectors, CCSDS orbit parameter messages, SANA Keplerian and equinoctial element sets in OCM, Basilisk first-order J2 Brouwer mean/osculating elements, Basilisk J2-J6 zonal perturbation acceleration, Basilisk solar radiation pressure acceleration, and Basilisk Hill relative states.

externalInterfaces.description: Epoch normalization is delegated to foundation/time; this module treats OMM epochs as opaque SDS timestamps and does not duplicate time-scale conversion logic.
